name: Urdaneta Speedcubing Open 2024

venue.name: SM City Urdaneta Central
venue.details: Level 3, Hallway, In front of All About Baking

information:
This is the continuation of WCA speedcubing competitions in the City of Urdaneta!

The base registration fee is Php 350, good for 3 events/puzzles. Additional events registered shall entail Php 50 additional registration fee each. For more specific details, check Payment Details tab.
